mapper.sql: SELECT o.fulfilled_at event_at,o.partner_id,o.partner_name,i.book_id,i.book_title,i.line_total gross_amount,0 return_amount,i.quantity shipped_quantity,0 returned_quantity FROM sales_orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id WHERE o.fulfilled_at >= #{from} AND o.fulfilled_at < #{toExclusive} UNION ALL SELECT r.returned_at,o.partner_id,o.partner_name,i.book_id,i.book_title,0,ri.amount,0,ri.quantity FROM order_returns r JOIN sales_orders o ON o.id=r.order_id JOIN return_items ri ON ri.return_id=r.id JOIN order_items i ON i.id=ri.order_item_id WHERE r.returned_at >= #{from} AND r.returned_at < #{toExclusive}
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(e.event_at,'%Y-%m') label, FROM () e GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(e.event_at,'%Y-%m') ORDER BY label
SELECT MIN(e.book_title) label, FROM () e GROUP BY e.book_id ORDER BY net_amount DESC,e.book_id LIMIT 20
SELECT MIN(e.partner_name) label, FROM () e GROUP BY e.partner_id ORDER BY net_amount DESC,e.partner_id LIMIT 20

SELECT i.book_id,i.quantity_on_hand,b.title,b.isbn,b.active FROM inventory i JOIN books b ON b.id=i.book_id WHERE b.active=TRUE AND i.quantity_on_hand <= #{lowStock} ORDER BY i.quantity_on_hand,b.id LIMIT 20
